append the player after the image finishes opening. void video.play().catch(() => { if (player === video) { video.hidden = false } }) } const positionPlayer = () => { const image = document.querySelector('.medium-zoom-image--opened') if (!player || !image) { return } const { left, top, width, height } = image.getBoundingClientRect() Object.assign(player.style, { left: `${left + window.scrollX}px`, top: `${top + window.scrollY}px`, width: `${width}px`, height: `${height}px`, }) document.body.append(player) } zoom.on('open', startPlayer) zoom.on('opened', positionPlayer) zoom.on('close', removePlayer) zoom.on('closed', restoreFocus) return () => { zoomRef.current = null zoom.off('open', startPlayer) zoom.off('opened', positionPlayer) zoom.off('close', removePlayer) zoom.off('closed', restoreFocus) removePlayer() if (zoom.getZoomedImage()) { zoom.on('closed', () => zoom.detach(), { once: true }) void zoom.close() } else { zoom.detach() } } }, [videoSrc]) return ( <button ref={triggerRef} className="video-poster-trigger" onClick={event => { event.stopPropagation() void zoomRef.current?.open() }} type="button" aria-label={alt ? `Play video: ${alt}` : 'Play video'} > <img {...imageProps} ref={imageRef} alt={alt} /> </button> ) }
